effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by deleting 1 of your level 2 Digimon in the breeding area, reduce the cost by 2.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] By returning 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names from your trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Gizmon: AT] from your trash without paying the cost.
